national_news.title: India Targets Exceeding $220 Billion Renewable Energy Investment by 2030
bullets: Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi announced at the BRE Summit 2026 that India expects to exceed its $220 billion investment target for adding non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030.
India's current installed non-fossil fuel power capacity stands at 310 GW, with a set target of achieving 500 GW by 2030, alongside plans to prepare for an additional 300 GW.
Over the past two years, ₹7 lakh crore in domestic and foreign direct investments have entered the sector; the Ministry is also framing guidelines for recycling solar module waste.

national_news.title: International Day for Biosphere Reserves Highlights India's Conservation Model
bullets: On International Day for Biosphere Reserves (November 3), key focus was drawn to India's 18 nationally notified Biosphere Reserves, out of which 13 belong to UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
Designated in 1986, the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve was India's first, while Himachal Pradesh’s Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve was included in UNESCO's network in 2025.

Biosphere reserves integrate three connected zones—Core (strict protection), Buffer (research and ecotourism), and Transition (settlements and sustainable livelihoods)—to harmonize ecology with human activity.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Key Schemes for Fast-Track Courts, Energy Storage, Statistical Reforms, and Critical Minerals
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast Track Special Courts (exclusive POCSO courts) for five years starting April 1, 2026, with a total outlay of Rs 3,788.04 crore (Central share of Rs 2,353.15 crore funded via the Nirbhaya Fund).

Approved a Rs 14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme to build 92 GWh grid-scale energy storage capacity by 2030–31 (60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery storage, and 2 GWh emerging technologies), requiring a minimum 40% domestic content for battery projects.

Sanctioned the Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR) for modernizing national statistics using AI, alongside a new capital subsidy scheme to boost domestic processing of critical minerals like lithium, nickel, and cobalt.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Mandates Monthly Business Meets to Fast-Track Industrial Redressal
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed the Industries Minister and district authorities to organize mandatory monthly meetings with entrepreneurs to resolve administrative, land, and law-and-order issues.
Speaking at the 82nd annual function of the Bihar Industries Association (BIA), the CM called upon industry leaders to submit a draft proposal for a dedicated state pharmaceutical policy.
The BIA presented its 2025-26 memorial awards to Patel Agri Industries, Banke Bihari Foods, Badshah Industries, and former BIA president Arun Agrawal for their sector contributions.

bihar_news.title: Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway Planned as Bihar's First National Expressway
bullets: The proposed six-lane greenfield Patna-Purnia Expressway is set to begin at Mirnagar on NH-22 in Vaishali district and terminate at Chand Bhatti on NH-27 in Purnia.
The expressway alignment traverses five key districts: Samastipur, Darbhanga, Saharsa, Madhepura, and Purnia, enhancing east-west connectivity across northern and eastern Bihar.
Upcoming infrastructure proposals in the region also include a Central University near Vikramshila and the Ajgaibinath Greenfield Airport near Sultanganj in Bhagalpur district.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Fast-Tracks VB-G RAM G Scheme with 3 Lakh Rural Projects
bullets: Bihar state government expanded the Viksit Bharat-Rozgar evam Aajeevika Guarantee Mission-Rural (VB-G RAM G) target to 3 lakh projects with an allocation of Rs 22,000 crore.
The scheme guarantees 125 days of employment annually to rural households, with a strict mandate to disburse wages within 15 days.

Under the mission, each Anganwadi centre is allocated Rs 12 lakh for construction and Rs 2 lakh for furnishings and educational materials, alongside key interventions in water security and rural infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Roll Out AI-Powered e-Cabinet System
bullets: Bihar state government is preparing to launch an e-Cabinet system to transition cabinet decision-making into a 100% paperless, digital workflow.
The platform will integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to simplify complex administrative procedures and accelerate departmental approvals.
The initiative builds upon previous digital governance measures, including the UPYOG portal connecting 264 urban local bodies across the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Free Sugarcane Seed Scheme to Revive Closed Sugar Mills
bullets: The Bihar Sugarcane Department has launched a free seed distribution drive to boost sugarcane production around the Raiyam (Darbhanga) and Sakri (Madhubani) sugar mills, which have been closed for over three decades.
Farmers owning between 0.25 acre and 2.5 acres of land are eligible to apply online through the official portal (ccs.bihar.gov.in).
The program provides free improved seed varieties, financial assistance, and modern cultivation training to secure raw material supply prior to restarting the mills.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Two Portals for Diaspora Engagement and Investment
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister launched the 'Bihar Foundation Portal' and the 'Bihar Business Connect-2027 Portal' to connect the state's global diaspora and streamline investor registrations.
The Bihar Foundation currently manages 55 active chapters (31 international and 24 national), with targets to expand to 100 chapters by the end of the next financial year.
The state government also announced plans to establish 10 integrated centers across India to promote trade, investment, and tourism.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 24 GW Renewable Energy Capacity by 2030
bullets: Bihar pitched investment opportunities worth ₹2.57 lakh crore in its power sector at the India Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 in New Delhi.
Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, the state aims to achieve 24 GW of renewable energy capacity and 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
Key initiatives highlighted include the 301 MW Kajra Solar Power Project featuring a 523 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), alongside three signed MoUs for sector skill training and research.
